property_summary: For any caller and any deposit amount > 0, the reference contract either forwards the credited Ether to the caller (succeeds) and reduces its own balance by that amount, or it reverts when the callee reverts; the buggy mutant that removed the external call will never revert even when a callee reverts, so there exist inputs (a caller that reverts on receive) that make the mutant behave differently (no revert) while the reference reverts.
change_summary: Delete the external call, so withdrawAll no longer sends Ether and thus will not revert on failed calls (behavior differs for payable recipients).
